en.title: Completion of the first stage of engineering protection piling
works: Concreting of the engineering protection piles for the first phase was completed.
Installation of engineering protection structures continued.
Piles, concrete blinding and the reinforced concrete beam were completed.
Preparation of the base for the next structural stages began.
